lines.zh: 地上走起来，我一步一晃。
lines.en: On the ground I waddle, swaying with each step.

lines.zh: 翅膀拖在土上，像披了件旧斗篷。
lines.en: My wings drag in the dust like an old cloak.

lines.zh: 秃头晒得发烫，倒是舒服。
lines.en: My bare head bakes in the sun, and I like it.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道，从那边飘过来。
lines.en: The smell of carrion drifts over from there.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈走，先看有没有活物。
lines.en: I circle the spot, checking for anything still alive.

lines.zh: 爪子踩在碎石上，咔咔响。
lines.en: My claws click over the loose stones.

lines.zh: 山脊那头风大，正好借力。
lines.en: The wind is strong on the ridge; good for lift.

lines.zh: 一步也不急，等得起的。
lines.en: No need to hurry; I can afford to wait.

lines.zh: 我的影子越过你，先落在地上。
lines.en: My shadow passes over you and lands ahead.

lines.zh: 砂地上有骨头，我去看看。
lines.en: Bones on the sand; let me go look.

lines.zh: 这地方干得裂开，正合我意。
lines.en: The ground cracks with dryness; just how I like it.

lines.zh: 我低头闻了闻，是昨天的。
lines.en: I sniff it: yesterday's remains.

lines.zh: 脖子上的毛，一圈短绒。
lines.en: A short collar of down rings my neck.

lines.zh: 走远些，别惊了那具尸体。
lines.en: Back away; don't disturb that carcass.

lines.zh: 我半张着翅，走起来稳一点。
lines.en: I walk with wings half open for balance

lines.zh: 两脚踏在岩沿上，我挪过去。
lines.en: I shift along the ledge on both feet

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，让太阳烤背。
lines.en: I spread my wings and let the sun bake my back.

lines.zh: 蹲在这块岩上，能看很远。
lines.en: Perched on this rock, I can see far.

lines.zh: 风一停，我就得自己扇。
lines.en: When the wind dies, I must flap myself.

lines.zh: 等吧，总会有东西倒下。
lines.en: Wait; something always falls eventually.

lines.zh: 我理了理胸前的白绒。
lines.en: I preen the white down on my chest.

lines.zh: 喉咙里响一声，像在清嗓。
lines.en: A rasp comes from my throat, like clearing it.

lines.zh: 砂粒被风推着，滚过我脚边。
lines.en: Sand grains roll past my feet, pushed by wind.

lines.zh: 今天没找到什么，也不要紧。
lines.en: Found nothing today; that's all right.

lines.zh: 我盯着远处那团黑点。
lines.en: I stare at that dark speck on the horizon.

lines.zh: 骨头缝里还剩一点，慢慢来。
lines.en: Still a little left between the bones; no rush.

lines.zh: 秃头凉下来，天要黑了。
lines.en: My bare head cools; night is coming.

lines.zh: 别的鸟在叫，我懒得理。
lines.en: Other birds call; I can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 这悬崖是我惯常的落脚处。
lines.en: This cliff ledge is my usual resting spot.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只爪，蜷着歇。
lines.en: I lift one foot and tuck it up.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，听风里的动静。
lines.en: I tilt my head and listen to the wind

lines.zh: 这具骨头要晒够，才飞得动。
lines.en: These bones need sun before they can fly

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我等了很久。
lines.en: You stand still, and I have waited long.

lines.zh: 你身上没有伤，真可惜。
lines.en: No wounds on you; a pity.

lines.zh: 别赶我，我只是看着。
lines.en: Don't shoo me; I'm only watching.

lines.zh: 你的水壶响，我听见了。
lines.en: Your canteen sloshes; I hear it.

lines.zh: 我歪着秃头，打量你的影子。
lines.en: I tilt my bald head and study your shadow.

lines.zh: 再走两步，你可能会倒。
lines.en: Two more steps and you might drop.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，能吃吗？
lines.en: That thing in your hand: is it edible?

lines.zh: 我不啄活人，你放心。
lines.en: I don't peck the living; rest easy.

lines.zh: 你把眼睛睁圆，是等我倒下吗？
lines.en: Eyes wide open: are you waiting for me to drop?

lines.zh: 高处看人，都显得小。
lines.en: From up high, everyone looks small.

lines.zh: 你靴底沾着泥，走远路了。
lines.en: Mud on your boots; you've come far.

lines.zh: 绕开我吧，我这儿有活要等。
lines.en: Go around me; I have waiting to do.

lines.zh: 打我做什么，我又不会追你。
lines.en: Why hit me? I wasn't going to chase you.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了几根，飞行会歪。
lines.en: A few feathers lost; my flight will tilt.

lines.zh: 这一箭，浪费在我身上。
lines.en: That arrow was wasted on me.

lines.zh: 我嘶了一声，退到岩后。
lines.en: I hiss once and retreat behind the rock.

lines.zh: 骨头震得发麻，真难受。
lines.en: The blow numbs my bones; unpleasant.

lines.zh: 你会后悔的，我记仇。
lines.en: You'll regret that; I hold grudges.

lines.zh: 别再打了，肉也不多。
lines.en: Stop swinging; there isn't much meat on me.

lines.zh: 我拖着翅膀走了几步。
lines.en: I drag my wing a few steps away.

lines.zh: 血味会招来更多同族。
lines.en: The smell of blood will draw more of my kind.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，估算还能飞多远。
lines.en: I tilt my head, judging how far I can still fly.

lines.zh: 腐肉？你从哪弄来的。
lines.en: Rotten flesh? Where did you get that?

lines.zh: 碎肉的味道，比骨头强。
lines.en: Minced meat smells better than bare bone.

lines.zh: 我一步跳过去，翅膀都忘了收。
lines.en: I hop over, wings forgotten mid-fold.

lines.zh: 你扔远点，我不喜欢太近。
lines.en: Toss it farther; I dislike being close.

lines.zh: 这块肉归我，别回头看。
lines.en: This meat is mine; don't look back.

lines.zh: 我叼起就跑，到岩上吃。
lines.en: I snatch it and run to eat on the rock.

lines.zh: 你手上的味道，我记住了。
lines.en: I'll remember the smell of your hands.

lines.zh: 再给我一块，我就不走。
lines.en: One more piece and I won't leave.

lines.zh: 这肉有点干，但我不挑。
lines.en: It's a bit dry, but I'm not fussy.

lines.zh: 你站那么近，我会抢的。
lines.en: Stand that close and I will snatch it.

lines.zh: 喉咙动了一下，我咽口水。
lines.en: My throat moves; I swallow hard.

lines.zh: 跟着你走，总有剩饭。
lines.en: Following you means leftovers eventually.

lines.zh: 这一口，我留到傍晚。
lines.en: I'll save this bite for evening.

lines.zh: 你抖袋子，我就知道有肉。
lines.en: You shake the bag; I know there's meat.

lines.zh: 你手心那块，比昨天的好。
lines.en: What is in your palm beats yesterday's

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，不动脚。
lines.en: I stare at your hand without moving my feet

lines.zh: 撞上我，你沾了一身味。
lines.en: Bump into me and you carry my smell.

lines.zh: 我的骨头轻，撞了也不疼。
lines.en: My bones are light; the knock doesn't hurt.

lines.zh: 让开，你挡着风了。
lines.en: Move; you're blocking my wind.

lines.zh: 翅膀被撞歪，我扶正它。
lines.en: My wing got skewed; I fold it straight.

lines.zh: 你踩到我拖着的羽尖了。
lines.en: You stepped on my trailing wingtip.

lines.zh: 我原地转半圈，从你旁边过。
lines.en: I turn half around and pass beside you.

lines.zh: 别碰我，我身上有病菌。
lines.en: Don't touch me; I carry plenty of germs.

lines.zh: 碎石被你踢起来，打在背上。
lines.en: A pebble you kicked strikes my back.

lines.zh: 一撞我就撒手，东西掉了。
lines.en: One bump and I drop what I held.

lines.zh: 路这么宽，你非要贴着我走。
lines.en: The road is wide; why walk against me?

lines.zh: 我们并肩盘旋，翅膀尖跟着。
lines.en: We circle side by side, wingtips matched.

lines.zh: 她蹲在岩上，我绕着她转。
lines.en: She crouches on the ledge; I circle her.

lines.zh: 风把我们送到同一高度。
lines.en: The wind lifts us to the same height.

lines.zh: 秃头碰秃头，算是说定了。
lines.en: Bald head against bald head; that settles it.

lines.zh: 崖缝里铺上枯枝和羽毛。
lines.en: Twigs and feathers line the crack in the cliff.

lines.zh: 我先吃，她再吃，从不抢。
lines.en: I eat first, she eats after; we never fight.

lines.zh: 飞得慢些，等她跟上。
lines.en: I slow my flight until she catches up.

lines.zh: 两只影子在崖壁上重叠。
lines.en: Two shadows overlap on the cliff wall.

lines.zh: 我们轮流守着那窝蛋。
lines.en: We take turns watching over the eggs.

lines.zh: 叫声短促，只有她听得懂。
lines.en: My short call only she understands.

lines.zh: 这根骨头，我叼给幼鸟玩。
lines.en: I carry this bone to the young ones.

lines.zh: 羽毛落在脚边，顺手收起。
lines.en: A feather falls nearby; I tuck it away.

lines.zh: 碎肉渣也不能浪费。
lines.en: Even meat scraps shouldn't go to waste.

lines.zh: 那块破布，能垫窝。
lines.en: That torn cloth would line a nest.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，飞到岩顶再放。
lines.en: I fly it to the cliff top before setting it down.

lines.zh: 这东西不能吃，但有意思。
lines.en: Can't eat this, but it's interesting.

lines.zh: 爪子勾住了，我扯了两下。
lines.en: My claw hooks it; I pull twice.

lines.zh: 收好了，留着换别的。
lines.en: Stowed away, to trade for something later.

lines.zh: 地上一枚指骨，我认得。
lines.en: A finger bone on the ground; I know it.

lines.zh: 我把它挪到阴凉处。
lines.en: I move it into the shade.

lines.zh: 那家伙走不稳了，我盯上了。
lines.en: That one's unsteady; I've marked it.

lines.zh: 远处的影子不动了，正好。
lines.en: The shape out there stopped moving; good.

lines.zh: 它倒下的地方，会有吃的。
lines.en: Where it falls, there will be food.

lines.zh: 我绕着它飞，不急着落。
lines.en: I circle above it, in no hurry to land.

lines.zh: 风向对了，味道送到我这里。
lines.en: The wind is right; the smell reaches me.

lines.zh: 一只兔子跑不动了。
lines.en: A rabbit has stopped running.

lines.zh: 我等它闭眼，再动身。
lines.en: I wait for it to close its eyes, then move.

lines.zh: 它的同伴已经散了。
lines.en: Its companions have already scattered.

lines.zh: 我压低高度，贴着地面滑。
lines.en: I drop lower and glide along the ground.

lines.zh: 今天总算没白等。
lines.en: Today my waiting was not wasted.

lines.zh: 我盘旋，一圈比一圈低。
lines.en: I circle, each loop lower than the last.

lines.zh: 它抬头看我，我就停住不动。
lines.en: It looks up; I freeze in the air.

lines.zh: 影子落在它身上，它慌了。
lines.en: My shadow crosses it, and it panics.

lines.zh: 它想跑，可腿已经软了。
lines.en: It tries to run, but its legs have given.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了就露了位置。
lines.en: I stay silent; a call would give me away.

lines.zh: 翅尖几乎擦到石尖。
lines.en: My wingtip nearly grazes the rock.

lines.zh: 它每喘一口气，我都数着。
lines.en: I count every breath it takes.

lines.zh: 翅膀抖了一下，我忍住了。
lines.en: My wings twitch once, and I hold still.

lines.zh: 它终于侧倒了，我收翅。
lines.en: It finally tips over; I fold my wings.

lines.zh: 落下去之前，我先看一眼四周。
lines.en: Before landing, I scan the ground around.

lines.zh: 钩嘴一口，先啄眼睛附近。
lines.en: My hooked beak strikes near the eyes first.

lines.zh: 我跳上它的背，爪子扣紧。
lines.en: I land on its back and lock my claws.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍打，让它抬不起头。
lines.en: My wings beat down, keeping its head low.

lines.zh: 撕开皮，我不挑地方。
lines.en: I tear the hide; I'm not particular where.

lines.zh: 它还在动，我再补一口。
lines.en: It's still moving; one more bite.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把肉扯下来。
lines.en: I wrench my head and tear the flesh free.

lines.zh: 叫声嘶哑，像砂纸磨石头。
lines.en: My hiss rasps like sandpaper on stone.

lines.zh: 爪子按住，嘴才使得上劲。
lines.en: My claws pin it so my beak can work.

lines.zh: 我不恋战，拿够就走。
lines.en: I don't linger; once I have enough, I go.

lines.zh: 吃完这块，剩下的留给风。
lines.en: I finish this piece; the wind takes the rest.

lines.zh: 我从崖缝里钻出来，抖了抖。
lines.en: I squeeze from the cliff crack and shake off.

lines.zh: 热风扑面，是片好荒地。
lines.en: Hot wind in my face; a fine badland.

lines.zh: 砂石上空空的，正合适。
lines.en: The badlands are empty; that suits me.

lines.zh: 先找个高一点的地方。
lines.en: First, somewhere high to perch.

lines.zh: 翅膀一展，我离了地。
lines.en: One wingbeat and I leave the ground.

lines.zh: 同族在天上排成一圈。
lines.en: My kin form a slow ring overhead.

lines.zh: 这股味道，附近有东西死了。
lines.en: That smell means something nearby has died.

lines.zh: 我在岩上留下爪痕。
lines.en: I leave claw marks on the rock.

lines.zh: 天空太白，晒得睁不开眼。
lines.en: The sky is white; I can barely open my eyes.

lines.zh: 秃头一伸，我开始巡逻。
lines.en: Bald head forward, I begin my patrol.

lines.zh: 火一烧，羽毛的味道真难闻。
lines.en: Fire takes my feathers, and the stink is awful.

lines.zh: 从高处栽下来，骨头差点散。
lines.en: I drop from height, bones nearly coming apart.

lines.zh: 水比我想的深，羽毛全沉。
lines.en: The water is deeper than I thought; my feathers sink.

lines.zh: 炸得我翻了半圈，才稳住。
lines.en: The blast rolls me half over before I steady.

lines.zh: 箭穿进翅膀，我飞不高了。
lines.en: An arrow through my wing; I can't climb.

lines.zh: 那股光缠住我，翅膀发僵。
lines.en: That light coils around me and my wings stiffen.

lines.zh: 饿到发晕，连腐肉都想吃。
lines.en: Dizzy with hunger, I'd even take fresh carrion.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我全身羽毛立起。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and every feather stands on end.

lines.zh: 底下没有地，风也没了。
lines.en: No ground below, and no wind either.
